helldivers.title: Helldivers
helldivers.description: Helldivers are elite soldiers deployed by Super Earth to conduct high-risk missions across hostile worlds. They are launched from orbit aboard Super Destroyers and are expected to complete objectives under extreme battlefield conditions in service of Managed Democracy.

seaf.title: Super Earth Armed Forces (SEAF)
seaf.description: The Super Earth Armed Forces, commonly known as SEAF, are the conventional military forces of Super Earth. They defend Federation territory, operate military installations, and fight alongside the Helldivers throughout the Galactic War.

vote-snatchers.title: Vote Snatchers
vote-snatchers.description: The Vote Snatchers are an anti-Super Earth dissident movement that emerged during the Second Galactic War. Branded as enemies of Managed Democracy, the group has been associated with sabotage, propaganda, and attempts to undermine Super Earth's democratic institutions.

ministry-of-truth.title: Ministry of Truth
ministry-of-truth.description: The Ministry of Truth is one of the principal Ministries of Super Earth and is responsible for informing the public and protecting citizens from enemy propaganda and misinformation. It oversees official messaging, propaganda, and major media organizations such as Strohmann News, while also supervising programs focused on civilian surveillance, dissident detection, and resistance to Illuminate influence.

ministry-of-defense.title: Ministry of Defense
ministry-of-defense.description: The Ministry of Defense is responsible for defending Super Earth against all military threats. It commands the Super Earth Armed Forces and, by extension, the Helldivers. The Ministry also issues military directives, oversees Helldiver readiness, and plays a major role in the development and deployment of Warbonds and battlefield equipment.

ministry-of-science.title: Ministry of Science
ministry-of-science.description: The Ministry of Science is a Super Earth government organization responsible for scientific research, technological development, and investigation of unusual galactic phenomena. Its work has included research into the Terminid Control System, Termicide, the Gloom, E-711, Dark Fluid, and other major scientific projects connected to the Galactic War.

brasch-tactics.title: Brasch Tactics
brasch-tactics.description: Brasch Tactics is a military instructional broadcast hosted by General Brasch and shown aboard Super Destroyers. The program provides Helldivers with short battlefield lessons covering subjects such as cover, concealment, injuries, reloading, armored enemies, fire modes, tagging, and team weapons.
